logs: Review of hook-runner: Not ready to build on: 1 blocker and 9 major findings are open. The wiring generator drops every event matcher except PreToolUse's, never writes async, and wires a PreToolUse rule with no atoms only on Bash; H7's decisions gate in step 4 depends on the dropped UserPromptExpansion matcher. TOOL_ATOMS splits the two MCP atoms into fragments. A deadline blocks in brief and notify mode, and the brief fallback line is never printed. The locked flag is ignored. gitfs.head_sha returns None in a linked worktree on a branch. shell.parse misses substitutions outside the arguments and reports wrong `where` facts (~, $VAR, cd -, reserved words). test_rule_cases never reads tests/hooks/cases/. The async-with-a-gate-rule refusal is built against the wrong condition. Several promised behaviours have tests that cannot fail. All five checks pass and all 9 fixed findings are confirmed.. 21 findings, 10 blocker or major.
Round 1 for hook-runner: 13 of 21 fixes confirmed, 12 still open.

still_open.problem: The C1-1 fix made a command substitution invisible when an arithmetic span shares its word. _read_word assigns 'subst = _arithmetic_nests_substitution(...)' instead of OR-ing it in, so an earlier '$(' or backtick in the same word is forgotten. _own_opacity also skips any argument containing '$(('. As a result, 'echo $(rm -rf /tmp/x)$((1+2))', 'echo "$(id)$((1))"', 'echo `id`$((1))', 'X=$(id)$((1)) ls' and 'echo > $(id)$((1))' all parse as not opaque; before this round they were opaque. The form '$((cmd) )' is not opaque either, yet sh and bash run it as a command substitution ('sh -c "echo $((echo hi) )"' prints hi). Verified through the runner: an agent's 'vsdd survey $(echo pwned > /dev/null)$((1))' and 'vsdd survey $((echo pwned) )' both get the caller marker and permissionDecision 'allow' with updatedInput. That approves an arbitrary substitution without a prompt for agents and in auto or bypassPermissions mode, which HD8 forbids: the command may hold nothing else. No test covers a substitution and an arithmetic span in one word.
still_open.proposed_fix: In _read_word, OR the arithmetic result into subst on both the bare and the double-quoted path. In _own_opacity, drop the per-argument '$((' exclusion and rely on word.subst, or strip only the arithmetic spans that nest nothing before searching. Treat a '$((' span that does not close with '))' as a command substitution. The safest form: an arithmetic span is harmless only when it closes with '))' and holds only arithmetic characters. Add these opaque cases to test_shell.py: 'echo $(id)$((1))', 'echo "$(id)$((1))"', 'echo `id`$((1))', 'X=$(id)$((1)) ls', 'echo > $(id)$((1))' and 'vsdd survey $((id) )'. Add a test_caller.py test where an agent's 'vsdd survey $(id)$((1))' gets no marker and no decision. While there, fix an older gap: a '${...}' span holding '$(' sets no subst, so 'X=${y:-$(id)} ls' is not opaque.
